slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
“渊儿，上前一步。”
林家祖祠中央，一座复杂的筑基法阵正散发着幽绿的光芒。
阵眼处，盘坐着一名身穿鹤氅的老者，沙哑着开口。
他面色灰败如蜡，脸上布满了老年斑，皮肤干瘪，唯有一双眼睛，在绿光的映衬下显得格外炽热，犹如饿狼。
此人正是林家唯一的筑基老祖，林玄鹤。
筑基后期修为，如今已过两百四十岁，大限将至。
阵法外，一名身穿青衫的年轻男子恭敬跪地。
年方十八，面容清秀。
然而，他周身隐隐流转的锐利气息，却昭示着他炼气九层的充沛修为。
他叫林渊，林家旁系子弟，身负罕见的纯净金灵根。
“是，老祖。”
林渊低着头，声音带着一丝恰到好处的激动与颤抖，膝行上前，盘坐在林玄鹤身前三尺处的副阵眼上。
“你身负金灵根，乃是天生的剑修胚子。只可惜我林家资源匮乏，蹉跎了你十八年。”
林玄鹤伸出枯草般的手臂，轻轻抚摸着林渊的头顶，眼中满是慈爱，“今夜，老祖便以秘法化去自身百年修为，为你强行灌顶筑基。此后，林家便交到你手里了。”
“渊儿叩谢老祖恩典！此生定不负老祖栽培！”
林渊重重叩头，声音哽咽。
然而，在低垂的视线里，林渊却双眸冰冷。
感恩？
修仙界的真理只有一条：天上掉的绝不是馅饼，而是带毒的飞剑。
林渊修行多年，从不相信任何无缘无故的善意。

这三年来，为了验证自己的猜想，他暗中付出了太多。
三年前，他在祖祠密室的夹缝里，偶然发现了几具风化的师兄枯骨，他们的死状皆是天灵盖碎裂，神魂荡然无存；
半年前，他潜伏数月，终于偷听到林玄鹤在密室中癫狂地低语“肉身气血衰败，必须尽快换一具完美的容器”；
而这三个月来，林玄鹤每日赐下的养魂汤，美其名曰稳固识海，实则是为了软化他的神魂防线，方便外来者进驻！
换作旁人，恐怕早就惊慌失措地逃跑了。
但林渊很清楚，在一个筑基后期修士的眼皮底下，区区炼气期根本无处可逃。
所以，他没有跑。
他整整布局了三年，耗尽了自己做散修攒下的所有身家，今夜，就是生死一搏。
老东西，你想活，我也想活！
“好孩子，闭上眼，心神合一。”
林玄鹤的声音仿佛带着某种催眠的魔力。
林渊依言闭眼，呼吸渐渐平缓。
就在他闭眼的刹那，林玄鹤脸上的慈爱瞬间荡然无存，取而代之的是一抹近乎癫狂的狰狞！
“轰！”
毫无征兆地，林玄鹤的天灵盖上陡然爆发出刺目的绿芒。
content_en:
"Yuan'er, step forward."
In the center of the Lin family ancestral temple, a complex foundation-building array is emitting a green light.
At the center of the formation, an old man wearing a crane cloak sat cross-legged, speaking hoarsely.
His face was as gray as wax, covered with age spots, and his skin was shriveled. Only a pair of eyes looked particularly hot against the green light, like a hungry wolf.
This person is Lin Xuanhe, the only foundation-building ancestor of the Lin family.
After cultivating in the later stages of foundation building, he is now over two hundred and forty years old, and the end is approaching.
Outside the formation, a young man in a green shirt knelt down respectfully.
He is eighteen years old and has a handsome face.
However, the sharp aura faintly circulating around his body revealed his abundant cultivation at the ninth level of Qi refining.
His name is Lin Yuan, a descendant of the Lin family, and possesses a rare pure golden spiritual root.
"Yes, ancestor."
Lin Yuan lowered his head, his voice was filled with just the right amount of excitement and trembling, he walked forward on his knees and sat cross-legged on the assistant formation's eye three feet in front of Lin Xuanhe.
"You have golden spiritual roots and are a natural swordsman. It's a pity that my Lin family lacks resources and has wasted you for eighteen years."
Lin Xuanhe stretched out his withered grass-like arms and gently stroked Lin Yuan's head. His eyes were full of love, "Tonight, the ancestor will use secret methods to remove his own centuries-old cultivation and forcibly initiate and establish the foundation for you. From then on, the Lin family will be in your hands."
"Yuan'er, thank you for your ancestor's grace! You will definitely live up to your ancestor's cultivation in this life!"
Lin Yuan kowtowed heavily, his voice choked with sobs.
However, in his lowered gaze, Lin Yuan's eyes were cold.
grateful?
There is only one truth in the world of immortality: what falls from the sky is never a pie, but a poisonous flying sword.
Lin Yuan has been practicing for many years and never believes in any unreasonable kindness.
In the past three years, he had secretly paid too much to verify his conjecture.
Three years ago, he accidentally discovered several weathered bones of his senior brothers in the cracks of the secret room of the ancestral temple. Their death state was that their heavenly spirit caps were shattered and their souls were gone;
Half a year ago, after lurking for several months, he finally overheard Lin Xuanhe whispering crazily in a secret room, "The physical body's energy and blood are declining, and a perfect container must be replaced as soon as possible";
In the past three months, the soul-nourishing soup given by Lin Xuanhe every day was euphemistically called "stabilizing the sea of consciousness," but it was actually intended to soften his soul's defense line and make it easier for outsiders to enter!
Anyone else would have run away in panic.
But Lin Yuan knew very well that under the eyes of a monk in the late stage of foundation building, there was nowhere to escape in the Qi refining stage.
So, he didn't run.
He had been planning for three years and spent all the money he had saved as a casual cultivator. Tonight was a life-or-death battle.
Old man, if you want to live, I want to live too!
"Good boy, close your eyes and unite your mind."
Lin Xuanhe's voice seemed to have some kind of hypnotic magic.
Lin Yuan closed his eyes as he was told, and his breathing gradually became calmer.
The moment he closed his eyes, the kindness on Lin Xuanhe's face disappeared instantly, replaced by a look of ferocity that was almost crazy!
"Boom!"
Without any warning, Lin Xuanhe's Tianling Cap suddenly erupted with a dazzling green light.
